lead.title: Adcendo's anti-uPARAP ADC posts a 30% objective response rate in advanced soft tissue sarcoma, a tumor that resists chemotherapy
lead.deck: Presented as a late-breaker at the EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium in Barcelona on November 19, the Phase 1/2 ADCElerate1 study of ADCE-D01 (an anti-uPARAP antibody armed with a deruxtecan payload) enrolled 47 patients across 17 sarcoma subtypes: on the every-two-weeks schedule, 8 partial responses in 27 evaluable patients (30%) and 85% disease control, with all responses ongoing, no interstitial lung disease, no discontinuations for toxicity and no maximum tolerated dose reached. The Copenhagen biotech, which closed a $75M Series C led by Jeito Capital in April and already holds FDA Fast Track and orphan drug designations, has in uPARAP a novel target in a cancer where options after first line are thin.

milestone.title: BioVersys shows in Phase 2a that a tuberculosis regimen built on alpibectir-ethionamide can replace isoniazid
milestone.summary: In the 14-day ENABLE trial (EU project UNITE4TB, run by TASK in patients with drug-sensitive pulmonary tuberculosis), every AlpE-containing regimen showed early bactericidal activity; alpibectir 45 mg + ethionamide 250 mg combined with rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol delivered activity numerically close to standard HRZE, and was well tolerated. Results were presented on November 20 at the Union World Conference on Lung Health in Rio.
milestone.why: Alpibectir, co-developed with GSK and born at Institut Pasteur de Lille, potentiates an old antibiotic so it can be dosed lower and get around resistance: a path to shorter regimens against drug-resistant tuberculosis. The Phase 2b STEP2C trial, testing AlpE-RZE over the first two months of treatment in six African countries, is already underway.

brefsEurope.title: Avacta moves AVA6207, a FAP-activated dual-payload (exatecan + ATR inhibitor) peptide-drug conjugate, into IND-enabling studies
brefsEurope.summary: Preclinical data presented in Barcelona show reversal of topoisomerase 1 inhibitor resistance and complete responses in mice bearing patient-derived ovarian and lung tumors, plus superiority over Enhertu in a gastric model. The candidate enters IND-enabling studies in Q4 2026, with biomarker-driven enrollment planned (SLFN11-low or ATM-deficient tumors).

brefsEurope.title: multiQure starts manufacturing MQ-201, an RNAi gene therapy that silences only the mutant copy of the Huntington's gene
brefsEurope.summary: The Warsaw-listed company has picked US CDMO Andelyn Biosciences to make the AAV5 vector and, with Warsaw's Bródno Hospital and Munich consultancy Granzer on the IND package, is preparing a first dosing in patients, funded by PLN 50M raised in June. It is positioning behind uniQure's AMT-130, whose FDA decision is due May 1, 2027.

brefsEurope.title: FDA grants Noema Pharma orphan drug designation for basimglurant in trigeminal neuralgia
brefsEurope.summary: The oral mGluR5 negative allosteric modulator, which already had Fast Track in this rare facial pain disorder (about 150,000 patients in the US), gains up to seven years of potential US market exclusivity. The Sofinnova-backed Basel biotech had won FDA clearance back in 2022 for a Phase 2/3 trial in this indication.

brefsEurope.title: Laverock Therapeutics names Parker Moss, Exscientia's former corporate development head, as CEO ahead of a Series A planned for 2027
brefsEurope.summary: Paul J. Sekhri, who chaired Longboard Pharmaceuticals through its sale to Lundbeck, becomes executive chair; founder David Venables steps down on December 31. The preclinical company aims to select a candidate from its CAR-T programs in the first half of 2027.

brefsEurope.title: European Commission approves VaxRabeo, Sanofi's next-generation rabies vaccine, for all ages
brefsEurope.summary: Made on Vero cells, the vaccine covers pre-exposure prophylaxis (WHO's reduced 2-dose schedule) and post-bite prophylaxis (4 doses), with 100% of participants reaching protective antibody levels with intramuscular dosing. A 60-month shelf life and stability up to 27°C for 96 hours make it a comparable for the value of thermostability in vaccines.

brefsEurope.title: Lausanne-born Onward Therapeutics closes a TWD 900M (about $28M) Series B for programs targeting cancer drug resistance
brefsEurope.summary: The round, closed in two tranches, brings together existing shareholders CDIB Capital Healthcare Ventures and Hong Kong Chlitina plus Beiley Biofund, Everbright Biofund and Top Taiwan Venture Capital, with no named lead. The company, which moved its headquarters to Taiwan in 2025 while keeping an R&D team in Lausanne, aims to list on Taipei's Emerging Stock Board by end-2027.

brefsIntl.title: Merck and Kelun-Biotech's anti-TROP2 ADC sac-TMT improves overall survival in Phase 3 in advanced gastroesophageal cancer
brefsIntl.summary: The TroFuse-015 trial (473 patients in third line or later) met its primary endpoint against physician's choice, regardless of TROP2 level, but missed on progression-free survival and response rate. Another milestone for topoisomerase 1 inhibitor-payload ADCs, the class dual payloads aim to surpass.

brefsIntl.title: PAQ Therapeutics reports first clinical data for PT0253, a selective KRAS G12D degrader, with 6 responses in 7 first-line pancreatic cancer patients
brefsIntl.summary: As monotherapy (44 patients, 10 to 750 mg weekly), no dose-limiting toxicities and 3 confirmed partial responses in 10 RAS-inhibitor-naive pancreatic cancers; combined with mFOLFIRINOX, 6 objective responses in 7 evaluable patients, including one complete response. Targeted degradation gains clinical proof on the most coveted oncogene.

word.definition: A "guided missile" antibody that carries not one but two different toxic molecules, released together inside the tumor to strike through two mechanisms at once and stop the cancer cell from adapting.

parts.label: Carrier
parts.role: the antibody (or peptide) that recognizes the tumor target, e.g. HER2

parts.label: Branched linker
parts.role: the attachment that can hold two payloads, stable in blood and cleaved in the tumor

parts.label: Two payloads
parts.role: often a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor paired with an ATR inhibitor or the auristatin MMAE

how.t: The conjugate circulates without releasing its payloads and binds to cells expressing the target antigen.
Once internalized, or cleaved by an enzyme in the tumor microenvironment such as FAP, it releases both molecules in the same place at the same time.
The first payload breaks DNA; the second blocks its repair (ATR) or hits another mechanism, cutting off cells that resist a single payload.

word.why: Topoisomerase 1 inhibitor ADCs (Enhertu, sac-TMT) dominate oncology, but resistance to their single payload is emerging: dual payloads are the most watched answer, promising a synergistic combination in one molecule instead of two treatments stacking their toxicities. Eli Lilly's buyout of CrossBridge Bio (up to $300M in April 2026) validated the thesis; the test in the coming months is to show in humans that the second payload adds more efficacy than toxicity.

startups.name: Callio Therapeutics
startups.use: Multi-payload ADCs based on Hummingbird Bioscience technology; anti-HER2 CLIO-8221 (topoisomerase 1 inhibitor + ATR inhibitor), first patient dosed in Phase 1 in March 2026; $187M Series A led by Frazier Life Sciences

startups.name: Avacta Therapeutics
startups.use: AVA6207, a FAP-activated pre|CISION peptide conjugate carrying exatecan + berzosertib; entering IND-enabling studies in Q4 2026

startups.name: Debiopharm
startups.use: MultiLINK linker suite and MLINK Duo technology for dual-payload ADCs (MMAE + exatecan), in preclinical proof of concept on mono- and bispecific antibodies
